rationale: The last five 5-minute candles are essentially motionless — all opening and closing at $22.16 with an ATR of only $0.01, indicating near-zero intraday volatility and no directional momentum in either direction. With such a compressed range there is no mechanical basis for a trade: the spread would consume a meaningful portion of any realistically achievable move, and the absence of news or any price structure (breakout attempt, failed rally, trend rejection) leaves no entry thesis to define. Given today's existing loss and the inability to identify a credible invalidation/target relationship with a $0.01 ATR, skipping is the appropriate response.
